lines.en: I call Rin and am immediately roped into a late night trip to the convenience store because 9:00 PM is apparently the most ideal time for sushi.
lines.zh: 我给 Rin 打了个电话，结果立刻被拽去一趟深夜便利店——因为晚上九点显然是吃寿司的最佳时间。

lines.en: I figure that both Futaba and Otoha are unable to go (Probably because 9:00 PM sushi adventures are frowned upon by most people), but I’m not put off by the fact that I might be slightly more insane than them.
lines.zh: 我猜 Futaba 和 Otoha 都去不了（大概是因为大多数人不赞成九点出门买寿司这种冒险），但我并不介意自己可能比她们俩更疯一点。

lines.en: In fact, it’s for that exact reason that I actually enjoy spending time with Rin.
lines.zh: 事实上，正因为如此，我才真的喜欢跟 Rin 待在一起。

lines.en: Sure, she’s light years above me in terms of innate insanity and not the type that just causes a person to black out and force himself on girls in the old district, but we’re {i}both{/i} still a little “out there,” I guess.
lines.zh: 当然，就天生的疯劲而言她比我高出好几个光年，而且也不是那种会让人断片、然后在旧城区对女孩子动手动脚的疯——但我想，我们俩{i}都{/i}还是有点“不太正常”。

lines.en: Plus, this convenience store is {i}not{/i} in the old district, which means the chances of me sexually assaulting Rin are statistically lower.
lines.zh: 再说，这家便利店{i}不{/i}在旧城区，也就是说我在统计上性侵 Rin 的概率会更低一些。

lines.en: Rin goes to pay for her sushi as well as a varied assortment of energy drinks but, lo and behold, conveniently managed to leave her wallet behind at the dorm.
lines.zh: Rin 去付她的寿司和一大堆功能饮料的钱，结果你猜怎么着，她“刚好”把钱包落在宿舍了。

lines.en: I try to get out of the idea of having to pay for her, but then I remember that I’m paying for her ex-crush’s phone bill and figure that Rin deserves at least {i}some{/i} form of compensation.
lines.zh: 我本想躲开替她付钱这回事，但随即想起我还在替她前暗恋对象交手机费，于是觉得 Rin 至少也该得到{i}某种{/i}补偿。

lines.en: I guess I also see it as a way of paying her back for all of the free drinks she’s given me. But hey, it’s not like I’ve ever actually {i}ordered{/i} any of those things.
lines.zh: 我想我也把这当成是回报她一直给我免费饮料的方式。不过话说回来，那些东西我其实从来都没{i}点过{/i}。

lines.en: Regardless, Rin gets her sushi and I get an empty promise that she’ll pay me back when I know she won’t.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Rin 拿到了她的寿司，而我拿到了一个她会还钱给我的空头承诺——我心里清楚她不会。

lines.en: After that, I am abandoned and left with slightly less money in my pockets while she returns to the dorm and eats away my hard work.
lines.zh: 之后我就被丢下了，口袋里少了点钱，而她回宿舍去消化我的辛苦钱。
